texts.text: <color=#515aee>Seasoned... and inquisitive...</color>
Oooof... Aw, man. Been a while since I got to really rest my bones. Guess it's my turn now, huh?
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Well, it couldn't have come at a better moment. I was just about out of cigs, and all this sitting around was making me stiff in the joints. Hard to get a smoke in here, anyway. Everybody's been raising hell about me lighting up in such a cramped place.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Besides, the folks who went ahead of us kept coming back with all sorts of stories. Couldn't make heads or tails of half of what they were saying.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: <What kinda stories?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Well... I just had a word with Frau Faust. She said the second floor was a space painted all over with flesh and bone...
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Yes.
texts.speaker: Faust

texts.text: Then Don Quixote told me about how you fellas got jumped by a... bunch of walking furnishings, or something like that...
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: <That one is... also true.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: What else, what else... Oh, right. A pair of big metally claws cracked Meursault's cranium open, I hear. Any truth to that?
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: If by "big metally claws" you are referring to the entity wielding a pair of oversized scissors, then yes.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Boy, sounds like you had your hands full.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: I finally take in the sight of the basement around us—it felt entirely different from the floors above.
<So... what's this place supposed to be? Let's see what the signboard says...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: "Fresh Meat Section".
texts.speaker: Faust

texts.text: <Are they serious...?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: We were surrounded by unidentifiable slabs of flesh, which were unceremoniously packed into displays without any perceivable intent or effort to make any of them look appetizing.
Fresh Meat Section, huh. This place would've killed even Rodya or Ezra's appetite, and that was saying something.
<We're supposed to find this... cocoon... in here?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Oh, that's what we're here for? Let's see...
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Well... That's just great. Might as well be looking for a needle in a haystack.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: ... Did they put me on this team because I'm considered a bug myself?
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: <I-I doubt it.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: The rationale behind the Sinner selection cannot presently be inferred, but that particular explanation is implausible, Herr Gregor.
texts.speaker: Faust

texts.text: It was a joke. A joke. Can't a guy make a little quip once in a while?
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: <At least try to sound like you're joking next time...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: While we were discussing our next move, I heard whispering nearby—two people were talking, both of them customers, most likely.
... Think they might be Noirs?
texts.speaker: Thirsty Kaki

texts.text: No! Look at that wallet—they've got to be the Rouges!
texts.speaker: Hungry Kaki

texts.text: Either way, they're clearly in higher tiers than us...
texts.speaker: Thirsty Kaki

texts.text: Th-they saw us. Should we run?
texts.speaker: Hungry Kaki

texts.text: No. They're obviously loaded. Maybe they'd be willing to give us a few eyeballs...
texts.speaker: Thirsty Kaki

texts.text: <... Why don't we ask them about the cocoon?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Sure. I can tell they're locals even at first glance. Let's see what they know.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Hey, fellas! Yeah, you two—the ones in the rags. Both of you!
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Y-yessir?
texts.speaker: Thirsty Kaki

texts.text: When the two customers approached, Meursault showed them the picture of the cocoon from the recipe.
Have you ever seen a cocoon resembling this one?
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: I-I don't think so...
texts.speaker: Hungry Kaki

texts.text: Sure looks tasty... maybe it's some new menu that's caught on at the Food Court?
texts.speaker: Thirsty Kaki

texts.text: Hmm... Doesn't look... very... edible to me...
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Gregor glanced at the condition of the meat chunks strewn around us and let the sentence trail off.
... Though the people here might say otherwise.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: <Maybe we should try the Food Court?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Which route leads to the Food Court?
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Well, that's...
texts.speaker: Thirsty Kaki

texts.text: 10 eyeballs, and we'll tell you right away!
texts.speaker: Hungry Kaki

texts.text: 10? You should've asked for 30! 10 barely buys one cup of soda!
texts.speaker: Thirsty Kaki

texts.text: Shut up! What if we ask for that much and they refuse?
texts.speaker: Hungry Kaki

texts.text: <Let's just pay them what they want and get the directions.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Understood, Manager.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Ahem. Go out into that corridor and follow the spiral shells.
texts.speaker: Hungry Kaki

texts.text: Spiral shells?
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: F-for another 10 eyeballs, we can explain—
texts.speaker: Thirsty Kaki

texts.text: They are likely... shells of snails.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: That area had once been their habitat, most likely.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: It appears we have obtained all necessary information. Do we have any further business here?
texts.speaker: Faust

texts.text: As soon as Faust finished speaking, the customers' eyes darted about, exchanging glances. Then they scurried away, our eyeballs preciously nestled in their hands.
We will proceed to the Food Court next.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <... What the...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <So... one of these escalators leads down to B2F... Supposedly...?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: With this many escalators, it's gonna take us all day to find it, even if we split up.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: We cannot search separately. As I am the subject of this Symbolic realm, the Sinners who are bound to me must not move beyond a certain distance from me.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: <Right. We can't split up...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Even so... with sufficient luck... the search might end sooner than expected.
texts.speaker: Faust

texts.text: <All right. Let's all find the way down.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: An ascending escalator with no end in sight. There is no telling where it might lead.
A descending escalator whose depth is impossible to gauge. Perhaps its far end is sealed.
The way is blocked. What purpose could an escalator like this possibly serve?
Another day of abundance today. Better huddle around the fountain before someone steals my spot.
texts.speaker: Thirsty Kaki

texts.text: 5 hour rule, man... It's still food... Finders keepers...
texts.speaker: Hungry Kaki

texts.text: *glhhrrrk* *glhhrrrk*
texts.speaker: Hungry Kaki

texts.text: Huh. A talking doll... Are you another one of those Mannequin things?
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: I am not a doll, you hear?! I am the Sous Chef, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: To think I'd be compared to a Mannequin... I'll not be having that sort of cheek, you hear?!
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: <Sous Chef...?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: The second-highest rank in a kitchen, commonly referred to as the deputy or assistant head chef.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Exactly, you hear? Nobody outranks me except Boucher, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: <Far more a bigshot than I expected... despite appearances.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <Then maybe she knows where the Golden Cocoon is?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Faust nodded and stepped forward.
... We are searching for the Golden Cocoon.
texts.speaker: Faust

texts.text: We were informed that it could be obtained on Floor B1. Do you possess any relevant information?
texts.speaker: Faust

texts.text: The Golden Cocoon...? I don't know what it is, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: It refers to a golden object or an entity that surrounds the pupa.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: I don't know what a "pupa" is, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Ah... I suppose we gotta start explaning from there.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: <Yeah... The language of this place isn't exactly based on the common sense we're familiar with.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: But I've seen that golden twinkle, you hear? I wonder if you're talking about that specialty ingredient in Boucher's storeroom, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Mm, that's probably the one.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Good. Nice when things move along this quickly.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: But ingredients in Boucher's meat storage are not for sale, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Every last bit of them have to go into the soda, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Tch. We need it pretty badly ourselves... Any way we can work something out?
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Hmm... Maybe if you bring the right substitute, you can barter for it, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Let's see if you can be the right substitute, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Hmm... Certainly not you, you hear? Squid-ink heads come in all the time; they're dime-a-dozen, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: This one looks much too tough to cook, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Mm.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: And this one's... rare, but our brew doesn't need more stretched time, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: <Should I be relieved...?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: The Sous Chef circled us, sniffed the air, then stopped in front of Gregor.
She began hopping up and down, unable to contain her excitement.
So deep, so full-bodied...! Crazy flavor, you hear? I want it, you hear? It's so buggy-buggy, you hear?!
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: W-what do you want? And what's that about "buggy-buggy?!"
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Boucher'll sign off without a peep for that creepy-crawly arm, you hear? Tit-for-tat, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Huh...! Is she actually salivating for my arm? I'll be damned, that's a first.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: <I think they want to use Gregor's arm... as an ingredient.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: <But... Uh, is that even an option?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Cutting off Gregor's arm? Is that even possible in here...?
Thanks to Meursault, the rest of us can now physically interact with objects within Grand Magasin Sisyphe. We can now pick things up and move them around, but...

So far, it still seems that Meursault's the only one susceptible to injury and death here... at least from those inflicted by the customers of this place. I wasn't sure if that law extended to the rest of the Sinners.
More importantly...
This damned arm always grows back anyway, but...
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: <I... don't think we should do anything to your arm. Got a bad feeling about this—we don't know if it'll grow back without any other risks involved.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: I couldn't exactly say why,
But I had this feeling that the result of cutting off Gregor's arm within the Symbolic wouldn't be as simple as a new bug arm growing back from the stump.
Yeah, this place is supposed to be some kind of mental... uh, a weird space we shouldn't mess around in, right? Guess that kills the deal, then.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: If there's another item you would be willing to accept in exchange—
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Nothing else'll do now, you hear? Not after that delicious whiff of your buggy-buggy aroma, you hear?!
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: <She's not listening to reason at all...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Fine! I'll just have to make sure you contribute whether you want to or not, you hear?!
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Hand over the bug arm, you hear?!
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Oh, great... Straight to robbery she goes.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Time... Time out, you hear?! That hurts, you hear?!
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Look... you're the one who attacked us first. You know that.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: But... I neeeed the bug arm, you hear...? Need that buggy-buggy flavor...
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Alright, that's enough buggy outta you. You're really starting to—
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Heeeeugh! Y-you better not hit me again, you hear?! I'm gonna skedaddle, you hear?!
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Like I said, we're not the ones who started—hey!? She's getting away!
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: <... Aaand she's gone. What now?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: We still have more questions to ask. Pursuit would be the optimal course of action.
texts.speaker: Faust

texts.text: I'm not sure I'd call this place a "Food Court"...
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: She scampered off down that way. Come on, let's hurry after her.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Whew... You sure ran a long way. Look, let's not make things harder for the both of us.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: D-don't come any closer, you hear?!
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Tell us where Boucher is located, and we will cease our pursuit.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: B-Boucher won't give up the specialty ingredient anyway, you hear? It's rare and gourmet, you hear? It's going in the soda, you hear?!
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: You should've cut off the buggy-buggy arm for us, you hear? I'd have put in a good word and helped you barter it, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: C'mon~ We'll never know until we talk it over, right? Just introduce us to Boucher and let us handle the rest.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: O-okay, but only if you do me a favor, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Now we're getting somewhere. All right, what do you want?
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Let me lick that buggy-buggy arm, you hear? Just three times, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Gregor's face contorted as though the skin were about to fall off his face.
<I mean, if all she wants is a lick or two, then...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Easy for you to say, Manager Bud. It's not your arm that's getting licked, is it?
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Try putting yourself in my shoes. Suppose that little fella asked you if she could run her hands through your flame hair 3 times. Wouldn't it feel icky?
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: <Remember what Bamboo-hatted Kim did to me the other day? Believe me, I know what it's like, but it's nothing you can't take.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Ugh...
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: The terms are favorable to us.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: ... Please say yes, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: <Licking's way less dangerous compared to, well, amputation...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: It's just me against the world, huh...? Fine, do whatever you want.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: The Sous Chef pointed to the butcher shop above, then latched onto Gregor's arm.
Boucher is in that big butcher shop up there, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Ughhh... *groan* dammit...!
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: <A butcher shop... What exactly does Boucher do, anyway?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: The Manager wishes to know what manner of individual Boucher is.
texts.speaker: Faust

texts.text: Boucher is the Floor Manager, you hear? He handles all sorts of work across B1, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Then what do you do? Hey, HEY! stop licking! You said three licks only!
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: That was nowhere near enough, you hear...?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: And I'm the Sous Chef, you hear? Of course I'm in charge of flavoring the Food Court soda, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Th-that... was a tastebud tickler, you hear? I want more... but all right, let's get going, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: ... You brought strangers with you. What is it, Head Chef?
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: It's Sous Chef; not Head Chef, you hear? I got promoted last time, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: *sigh*... Yes. You were promoted from Sous Chef to Head Chef.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: But Sous Chef sounds fancier, you hear? Which means I was promoted to Sous Chef, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: ... Why have you come here, Sous Chef?
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: I brought them because they need the specialty ingredient in the storeroom, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: More precisely, we require the Golden Cocoon. We cannot surrender Gregor's arm, but we could offer eyeballs—
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: I don't need eyeballs—already got more than I know what to do with.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: Besides, I don't know if we even have any left in stock... The season's nearly over, you see.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: Sous Chef, go check how many beached larvae we have in the storeroom.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: On it, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: There's only one still breathing, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: ... Just one? How'd that happen?
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: Because we've been using larvae to flavor the soda up season after season, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Getting living larvae's become a real toughie these days, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: So there are no more larvae left to wash ashore. I suppose this is where the last vestiges of the previous age finally vanish without a trace...
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: ... It may be time to start using something else as the base ingredient. What substitutes do we have?
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: Camemblack Scabbardfish... Golden Resin... Ruminations of the Prey... and the buggy-buggy arm, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: ... My arm's out of the question, you hear? Quit pushing it.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Anyways, that "larva" you mentioned—is that the Golden Cocoon?
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Correct. It's only the most flavorful part attached to the larva.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: <So it really was food...>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Ruminations of the Prey. Yes, that cut of meat will do. We've not been using it much on account of it being difficult to get, so you should be able to get your hands on a fresh cut.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: Where can we acquire it?
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: So you will bring it here? Very well. Provide us the ingredient, and we will peel a Golden Cocoon off the remaining larva for you.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: It's dingle-dangling from the ceiling, you hear? Dry-aged in layers of Golden Hide, you hear?!
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Food testers at the Fresh Meat Section are probably having one hell of a time aging it, so procuring it'll probably be a bit more involved than just going down there and plucking it off the hook. Well, I'll leave it to you to deal with the annoying part of the job.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: Sous Chef. I have a question.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: W-what is it, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: I want to know what form the Ruminations of the Prey take and by what criteria they may be identified.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: I don't know, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: We intend to contribute to the Meat Soda. Your guidance would be appreciated.
texts.speaker: Faust

texts.text: Hey... Soup Chef.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: I don't know, you hear?! I don't know!
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Good grief... *puff* All right, "Sous Chef."
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: How're we supposed to get you that Ruminations thing if you won't even tell us what it looks like? Come on, we're trying to make a "contribution" here—you're the Sous Chef, aren't you? Act like one.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: The buggy buggy arm would be perfect... but the Meat Soda matters more for everyone's sake, you hear? I'll answer because I'm a good, responsible Sous Chef, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: The Ruminations of the Prey hang at the far left, you hear? They dangle-dongle, you hear? Something glitters between the ribs, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: <... Then we should look for a cut of meat with the Golden Hide attached.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Oh? You could've told us from the start, you know. Would've saved us both a lot of trouble.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Wondering if you don't hate that arm, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: ... I do hate it. Like you wouldn't believe it. I don't go a day without wanting to rip it clean off my body.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: That you can just contribute, you hear? Wondering why you wouldn't, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Sometimes, Sous Chef... there are things that stick to you no matter how much you hate them, you hear?
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: I still want it... But if that's so, cherish it, you hear? Now I must go, you hear? You're not the only one who's busy, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: <Oh, wow.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: You transitioned between persuasion and intimidation with notable fluency, Gregor. Faust must admit that Faust has learned something today.
texts.speaker: Faust

texts.text: It was an exceptionally effective method.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Eh... Since when did you start giving me compliments like that, fellas? ... Ahem. Anyhow... Let's get moving.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: The Ruminations of the Prey hang on the far left, you hear? They dangle-dongle, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: It's goodbye now, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: A desiccated slab of meat, closer to jerky than anything else. The description insists it is exceptionally fresh...
A cut of rib eye, the marbling blooming like a flower... quite literally.
What blooms there is the rot. Is it even edible?
Its juice has frozen and turned blue. It is meat juice, right...?
Obtained the "Ruminations of the Prey."
<Whew. That didn't take too long.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: The talk-too-much runt is annoying enough, but all those other bastards drooling over the meat are worse. Tch.
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: The meat contains a minute quantity of the Golden Hide. It's reasonable that they want it for themselves.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: We should now return to Boucher.
texts.speaker: Faust

texts.text: <Let's go.>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Back in one piece, I see. Thought I'd find at least four arms dangling from meat hooks beside flambé-head.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: Where's the Ruminations of the Prey?
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: *sniff* *sniff* The smell, you hear? I can smell it, you hear? You got the right one, you hear?
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: Put it in the storeroom before it spoils.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: And we'll see that they're given a fair reward for it. Bring a larva here—the one that's still squirming.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: Be right back, you hear?!
texts.speaker: Sous Chef

texts.text: One thing before I hand over the goods. You don't need the larva, do you? You need just the Golden Cocoon?
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: Correct.
texts.speaker: Meursault

texts.text: Excellent.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: Through the window, we saw Boucher's mouth splitting open into a toothy grin as he began hacking into the ingredients the Sous Chef had brought him.
Take it, guests. The Golden Cocoon you requested.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: <... Is it... crying?>
texts.speaker: Dante

texts.text: Ugh... Not the most pleasant sound in the world, is it?
texts.speaker: Gregor

texts.text: Why would it be? The dish was only just born. To come into the world is to be swallowed by terror, and terror is such a lonely thing—which is, naturally, accompanied by weeping.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: ... In any case, I must begin preparing for service. I would prefer that you leave if you have no further business here.
texts.speaker: Boucher

texts.text: Thanks for the win-win deal, you hear?

I step onto the first staircase behind Meursault.
